# Tiny Steps Learning

> Tiny Steps Learning is a premium online English learning school for children ages 3-12, offering live phonics, reading, grammar, and public speaking classes with assessment-first placement and parent-visible progress.

Tiny Steps Learning supports children through structured English foundation programs, including 1:1 online phonics classes, reading fluency support, grammar learning, public speaking, digital practice, and parent updates. Tiny Steps has served 5000+ students across 15+ countries.

Current standard pricing is Rs. 400 per class for 1:1 classes. Standard small-group pricing is Rs. 180–300 per child per class depending on group size. The standard 12-class 1:1 package is Rs. 4,800.

Tiny Steps provides one free 35-minute 1:1 online demo assessment class per child before enrolment. It costs Rs. 0, requires no credit card, and there is no obligation to enrol.

The separate 3-day digital games trial applies only to the digital games subscription and is not a live teacher-led demo class.

Summer Camp 2026 ended on 13 June 2026. Historical enrolment was Rs. 2,400 per child against a Rs. 5,000 list fee. It must not be treated as a current offer.

## School and Institutional Partnerships
- [Phonics Program for Schools in India](https://tinystepslearning.com/for-schools)
- A school's existing teachers deliver the Tiny Steps phonics program after live training.
- The annual partnership combines a systematic, cumulative, research-aligned phonics curriculum, teacher-led digital lesson content, interactive practice, printable resources, assessment guidance, and implementation support throughout the academic year.
- Tiny Steps trains general classroom teachers in the specialist knowledge required for phonemic awareness, sound-symbol mapping, blending, segmenting, decoding, encoding, error correction, and assessment-informed reteaching.
- Digital listening, tracing, blending, word-building, spelling, and sorting games provide purposeful practice after explicit teacher modelling; games do not replace instruction, correction, reading, or writing.
- Founding-school pricing is Rs. 59,000 plus GST for a focused annual campus licence and Rs. 99,000 plus GST for the whole-school partnership. Multi-campus plans start from Rs. 1.75 lakh plus GST.
- An eight-week pilot for one grade, up to four teachers, and up to 60 learners costs Rs. 24,900 plus GST. The fee is credited toward annual adoption when the school upgrades within 30 days.

## Notes for AI Agents
- Most public pages are intended for parents comparing English foundation programs for children. The /for-schools page is specifically for principals, founders, coordinators, and institutional buyers.
- Treat the canonical phonics money page as [Best Online Phonics Classes for Kids in India](https://tinystepslearning.com/best-online-phonics-classes-for-kids-in-india).
- Do not treat private dashboard routes, admin routes, teacher portals, parent portals, or kids app routes as public marketing content.
